command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $log=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'desktop-commander-remote.log'; $existing=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'desktop-commander.*remote' }; if(-not $existing){ $args='-NoProfile -WindowStyle Minimized -Command "npx --yes @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest remote *>> ''' + $log + '''"'; Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -ArgumentList $args -WindowStyle Minimized; Start-Sleep -Seconds 15 }; $running=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'desktop-commander.*remote' }; Write-Output ('FREDWIN_HOST=' + $env:COMPUTERNAME); Write-Output ('REMOTE_AGENT_RUNNING=' + [bool]$running); if(Test-Path $log){ $tail=Get-Content $log -Tail 50 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $needsAuth=[bool]($tail -match 'verify|pair|device authorization|sign in'); Write-Output ('PAIRING_MAY_BE_REQUIRED=' + $needsAuth) } else { Write-Output 'PAIRING_MAY_BE_REQUIRED=UNKNOWN' }; exit 0
reason: Restore direct Desktop Commander presence on Fred-Win without exposing pairing codes or tokens
